issue: Sleeping Geo appeared white during Begin and corrected itself only after zoomend
cause: The screen-pixel outline was converted to texture pixels using the Australia-wide camera scale. Its excessive radius overpainted the native-colour mask; zoomend later rebuilt it at the correct scale.

reproduction.test: Begin preserves native emoji colours before, during and after the flight

fix.framing: Overview/introduction raster preparation measures the actual artwork footprint and uses the shared 2D Fit target for sampling.
fix.resolution: Prepare destination-resolution texture before the first flight frame, retaining the bounded raster cache and texture limits.
fix.paint: Outline and native-colour policy remain enabled; no font-specific exception, disabled outline or timing delay.
fix.camera: Read-only destination measurement; no intermediate camera jump or anchor change.
